title: iRacing Mustang GT4 Zolder Guide 1:34.0 Ford Mustang GT4 Circuit Zolder GP Track Guide

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: 100 board or orange marshal's inlet, 60% to 100%, trail brake to 3rd

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: end of gravel patch, 50%, trail brake to 3rd

corners.line: no cut curbs, run wide, cut back
corners.mistakes: be aggressive on first curve, stay out of gravel trap

corners.label: T7
corners.braking: straighten the steering wheel, control the slide, brake in a straight line
corners.line: straighten the steering wheel, control the slide
corners.exit: get back on the gas very lightly, lift through the right hander, back on full gas

corners.label: T8
corners.braking: ahead of the 100 board, 80% brake pressure
corners.exit: back on the gas at the apex

corners.braking: midway between the armco and the 100 board, 65-70% brake pressure
corners.exit: back on the gas once we get to the first curve
